notes: REF-BM-02: captures title/description/favicon but never a preview image (metadata.py only parses title, meta-description, favicon). REF-BM-03: description can only be edited after save (folded into the note field via EditDialog) — there's no pre-save edit/preview step, AddBookmark only accepts a URL. REF-BM-04: no distinct 'description' field exists on the model (Bookmark has note_html/note_text only) — the captured description is merged into the note, so editing description-as-such isn't supported separately from the note. REF-BM-07: BookmarkCard renders favicon, title, url and tags but never the description/note excerpt. REF-BM-14: search has no `#tag` token support in the query string — tag filtering is a separate `tag` query param only (api/bookmarks.py, list_bookmarks). REF-BM-15: `_fts_match_expression` only ANDs bare terms and matches quoted phrases; there is no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesized-group grammar, so the literal-quoting rule for operators doesn't apply. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread flag/field anywhere in the model, API, or UI. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk-action UI/endpoints exist (BookmarkList/BookmarkCard only support single-item edit). REF-BM-23: notes are WYSIWYG-sanitized HTML from a contentEditable div (NoteEditor.tsx), not markdown source, and there is no separate rendered 'view' of the note distinct from the editable field. REF-BM-24: no snapshot capture (HTML or PDF) of any kind. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive flag, endpoint, or archived-list view; nothing to distinguish from delete. REF-BM-29: no bundle entity/endpoint anywhere (only ad-hoc query+tag params, not a saved/reusable filter). REF-BM-32: no settings model/endpoint/UI for sort default, page size, or font size (SortControl is just transient UI state, not a persisted setting).
